event.title: Aaron Rodgers Released by Steelers Following Critical Remarks About Coach Mike McCarthy
event.canonical_title: Aaron Rodgers Released by Steelers Following Critical Remarks About Coach Mike McCarthy
event.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers have released quarterback Aaron Rodgers after he publicly criticized head coach Mike McCarthy during an interview. Rodgers, who was benched for an upcoming game, described McCarthy as 'unhealthy' and accused him of falling asleep in meetings. This decision follows a series of negative comments made by Rodgers about the coaching staff.

timeline.title: Pittsburgh Steelers Release Aaron Rodgers Following Criticism of Coach
timeline.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers have released quarterback Aaron Rodgers shortly after he publicly criticized head coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on 'The Pat McAfee Show.' Rodgers accused McCarthy of falling asleep in meetings and missing walkthroughs, leading to tensions within the team. Steelers president Art Rooney II stated that 'insubordination will not be tolerated' in light of the incident.

event_overview.title: About Aaron Rodgers Released by Steelers Following Critical Remarks About Coach Mike McCarthy
event_overview.subject: Aaron Rodgers Released by Steelers Following Critical Remarks About Coach Mike McCarthy
event_overview.summary: This event concerns the Pittsburgh Steelers’ November 25, 2026 release of quarterback Aaron Rodgers after the club had moved him out of the starting role and he publicly criticized head coach Mike McCarthy. The team’s official announcement confirmed the release but did not state that Rodgers’ remarks were the reason, so the reported connection between the comments, benching, and transaction should be understood as contemporaneous reporting rather than an officially specified cause.

facts.label: Transaction date
facts.value: The Steelers listed Rodgers as released on November 25, 2026.

facts.label: Team and league context
facts.value: The Pittsburgh Steelers are an NFL club; Rodgers was released during the 2026 NFL regular season.

facts.label: Rodgers' Steelers tenure
facts.value: Rodgers originally joined Pittsburgh on a one-year contract in 2025 and was re-signed for 2026; the Steelers said he started 10 games in 2026 before his release.

facts.label: Coaching relationship
facts.value: Mike McCarthy was Pittsburgh’s head coach in 2026, and Rodgers had previously played under McCarthy in Green Bay before their reunion in Pittsburgh.

facts.label: Roster consequence
facts.value: Before the release, Pittsburgh’s initial 2026 depth chart listed Rodgers as the starting quarterback and Mason Rudolph behind him.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers the late-November 2026 benching, public dispute, and release, not Rodgers’ full career, every allegation or response, or subsequent waiver and free-agency developments.
